nativeChecks.qualification: Native release checks one history entry and 1024 selected keys, then undo checks project identity. It does not assert every native moved key frame or restore pre-drag selection after undo. Component regression covers all 1024 moved key frames. Step 03 screenshot is after undo and its footer shows 1014 selected keys.

independentCleanup.qualification: Independent read-only release verification; no signals or persistent power/display changes. Wrapper process snapshot occurred after completion and was empty. Scoped caffeinate PID 10625 is sourced from its pmset creation record in the run window; a live start-time identity was not captured.
